title: Piano Movers in Los Angeles | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Piano movers in Los Angeles: a crew of 4 with a padded board and straps, a $200 add-on to your hourly move, a 3-hour minimum and same-day moves possible.
heroSubtitle: A four-person crew with a padded piano board and straps, booked together with your hourly move — from hillside stairs to condo elevators.

faq.question: Do I need a separate piano mover if my whole apartment is moving?
faq.answer: No. The piano rides with the rest of your household on one hourly move: you book a four-person crew, and the $200 piano add-on is added to that job. The 3-hour minimum applies to the whole move, not to the piano on its own.

faq.question: Can you take a piano out of a Los Angeles high-rise or condo?
faq.answer: Yes, as long as the building releases a service or freight elevator for the move. Book the elevator window with management, send us the building’s insurance requirements, and we issue the COI for $50 ahead of time. We also check that the piano fits the elevator car before the crew arrives.

faq.question: My house sits on a hillside with outdoor steps. Is that a problem?
faq.answer: It is common in this city and the reason we send four movers with a piano board. Tell us how many steps there are and send a photo of the path when you book. That helps us estimate the time and plan where the truck can stand on a narrow street.

faq.question: Do you tune, store or dispose of pianos?
faq.answer: No. SOS moves pianos but does not tune, appraise, store or dispose of them. Book a tuner once the instrument has settled into its new room.

faq.question: Can you move my piano today?
faq.answer: Often, yes: a same-day job is on the table if a crew of four has room in its schedule, so call 909-443-0004 as early as you can. We work Monday through Sunday, 8AM – 6PM, and the piano has to fit inside that window.

faq.question: How is a piano move priced outside the city, for example in Orange County?
faq.answer: The model does not change: the hourly rate for four movers with a truck, the $200 piano add-on and the $30 gas fee. For addresses 30+ miles from our base the minimum is 4 hours instead of 3, and drive time beyond 10 miles is counted double.
